bedside-amber.purpose: Ink and action color of the bedside night look (ambient night, night nudges, kid mode and the Tomorrow board at night).

display.purpose: The Today clock and the Tomorrow board's leave-by time; scales to 10rem on the ambient screen.

title.purpose: Panel headings, timeline event titles, kid-mode labels.

body.purpose: Everything read up close, and every form field (16px floor).

label.purpose: Uppercase section labels, weekday headers, pills, badges. The smallest text on screen.

title-lg.purpose: Wordmark, week-grid day numbers, timeline times, the Tomorrow hero sentence.

title-sm.purpose: Card and row titles, h3, the quick-add box.

small.purpose: Secondary lines: notes, field labels, chips, the dense week grid.

shadows.name: board-lift
shadows.purpose: Panels, tabs, kid cards: one level above the board.

shadows.name: nudge
shadows.purpose: Nudge banners. Over ambient photos they are frosted instead; at night there is no shadow.

shadows.name: nudge-phone
shadows.purpose: Softer floating shadow for nudge banners stacked on phones (700px and below).

shadows.name: state-ring
shadows.purpose: Now, conflict and today rings without shifting layout.

shadows.name: frosted
shadows.purpose: Weather, person pills and nudge banners over ambient photos.

shadows.name: night-outline
shadows.purpose: Actions at night (active tab, +, Got it): amber outlines instead of solid fills. All other shadows are none at night: on the Tomorrow board, in kid mode and on night nudges.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: The star stamping onto a done tile.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Sheets arriving (rise 16px, scale from .97). Nudge banners use the same keyframes over .25s ease-out, toasts over .2s ease-out; night nudges do not pop.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tiles scale to .95, faces lift 2px, + scales to 1.06.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: The dot of an event happening now.

motion.name: hold
motion.purpose: Kid mode's hold-to-leave house fills from the bottom.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Slow pan and zoom on ambient photos and scenes; 2.4s crossfade.

nightTheme.trigger: body:has(.tb.night, .kid-space.night): the hub in night mode showing the Tomorrow board or kid mode
nightTheme.decorativeFilter: grayscale(.6) brightness(.8) on faces, avatars, emoji and aria-hidden decoration
nightTheme.actions: Active tab and + button become black with Bedside Amber text and inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(185,143,99,.6); the Tomorrow hero drops its tint to --surface and its time to --ink.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one strong action per sheet or panel.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Top navigation: pill tabs in a white tray.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;background:var(--surface,#fff);padding:4px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(24,32,58,.06),0 6px 20px rgba(24,32,58,.07);font-family:Figtree,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-tabs a{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted,#5B6583);text-decoration:none}.ds-tabs a:hover{color:var(--ink,#18203A)}.ds-tabs a.active{background:var(--btn,#18203A);color:var(--btn-ink,#fff)}.ds-tabs a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2569C9);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form field with a small bold muted label above; the field is body size so phones do not zoom.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font:700 .875rem Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#5B6583)}.ds-field input{font:500 1rem Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18203A);background:var(--surface-2,#F5F7FB);border:2px solid var(--line,#DCE1EC);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#5B6583);opacity:1}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#2569C9) 35%,var(--line,#DCE1EC))}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2569C9);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Person Toggle
components.description: A choice of who: face plus name in a 2px-bordered pill; pressed takes the person color as border and a 16% tint.
components.css: .ds-tog{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:2px solid var(--line,#DCE1EC);background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18203A);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px 4px 4px;font:700 1rem Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;margin-right:8px}.ds-tog:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 50%,var(--line,#DCE1EC))}.ds-tog[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--pc);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 16%,var(--surface,#fff))}.ds-tog:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2569C9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-face{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 22%,var(--surface,#fff));border:2px solid var(--pc);flex:none}

components.name: Who Chip
components.description: Someone shown, not chosen (event attendees, per-person plan progress): face plus name, no toggle ring, no pressed or hover state.
components.html: 👧Emma👨Dad 2 of 3

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Small status labels in the warn, bad, good or muted pair: a capsule on one line, a neat rounded block when it wraps.
components.html: 🚗 Needs a ride Clash Paid Tomorrow

components.name: Heads-up Chip
components.description: Today's heads-up row: 40px pills that open their card underneath. White for information, warn-tinted when it needs a decision; the open one shows a focus-blue ring.

components.name: Panel
components.description: The white, board-lifted container for each section; nested rows change tone (Cloud), never add a shadow.
components.html: Get ready
components.css: .ds-panel{background:var(--surface,#fff);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 1px 2px rgba(24,32,58,.06),0 6px 20px rgba(24,32,58,.07));padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;font:1rem/1.45 Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18203A)}.ds-panel h2{font:600 1.25rem Fredoka,Nunito,"Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif;margin:0}.ds-chip{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;width:100%;border:0;text-align:left;background:var(--surface-2,#F5F7FB);color:inherit;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;font:.875rem Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-chip b{color:var(--muted,#5B6583);min-width:66px}.ds-chip:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#2569C9) 8%,var(--surface-2,#F5F7FB))}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2569C9);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Chore Tile
components.description: The sticker chart: dashed person-colored border while waiting, solid with a stamped star when done.
components.css: .ds-tile{position:relative;width:104px;margin:8px;border:2px dashed color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 55%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 7%,var(--surface,#fff));border-radius:18px;padding:12px 6px 10px;display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font:600 .875rem Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18203A);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s}.ds-tile .e{font-size:2rem;line-height:1}.ds-tile:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 12%,var(--surface,#fff))}.ds-tile:active{transform:scale(.95)}.ds-tile:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2569C9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-tile.done{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--pc);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 20%,var(--surface,#fff))}.ds-tile.done::after{content:"★";position:absolute;top:-10px;right:-8px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 85%,#000);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:17px;animation:ds-stamp .35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.6,1)}@keyframes ds-stamp{from{transform:scale(0) rotate(-40deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tile,.ds-tile.done::after{animation:none;transition:none}}

components.name: Nudge Banner
components.description: One-line bottom banner with no side stripe: a 40px icon tile whose tint shows the kind, a truncating Fredoka title and a Got it pill. Past the leave time the title goes amber for five minutes, then berry.
components.css: .ds-nudge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18203A);border-radius:18px;padding:8px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.28);font:1rem Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:620px;margin-bottom:8px;animation:ds-pop .25s ease-out}.ds-nudge-main{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:0;background:none;padding:0;color:inherit;text-align:left;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer}.ds-nudge-ic{width:40px;height:40px;flex:none;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.35rem;background:var(--surface-2,#F5F7FB)}.ds-nudge.leave .ds-nudge-ic{background:var(--bad-bg,#FDE3E8)}.ds-nudge.bill .ds-nudge-ic{background:var(--warn-bg,#FFF0D2)}.ds-nudge.brief .ds-nudge-ic{background:var(--good-bg,#DDF4E7)}.ds-nudge b{flex:1;min-width:0;font:600 1.125rem/1.25 Fredoka,Nunito,"Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-nudge-main[aria-expanded=true] b{white-space:normal}.ds-nudge.late-soon b{color:var(--warn,#9A5B00)}.ds-nudge.late b{color:var(--bad,#B7263F)}.ds-nudge-act{flex:none;min-height:44px;border:0;background:var(--btn,#18203A);color:var(--btn-ink,#fff);border-radius:999px;padding:0 18px;font:700 1rem Figtree,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-nudge-act:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-nudge-main:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2569C9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-nudge-act:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2569C9);outline-offset:2px}@keyframes ds-pop{from{transform:translateY(16px) scale(.97);opacity:0}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nudge{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Homebase is the chart on the fridge, grown up into the whole household's calendar. Its heart is the moment a kid presses a tile and a star stamps on, or the last job of the day sets off confetti. Everything else (the timeline, the week grid, bills and plans) is laid out tidily around that heart on a calm, cool-grey board, so parents can scan it in a glance and kids can find their own face.

The board itself is quiet: a misty blue-grey background, white rounded panels, one dark navy for actions, and soft rounded type. The color comes from the people. Each member's color rings their face, tints their events and fills their tiles, so "who" reads before "what". Emoji do the work of illustration, which means a picture always sits next to the words for children who can't read yet.

Play is placed deliberately. Kid mode, the chore tiles and the celebrations are chunky, bouncy and big. Parent tools (forms, settings, the week grid, the nudge feed) keep the same rounded shapes but stay orderly and restrained. It must never look like a corporate calendar (thin lines, grey boxes, dense text) or like a toy (primary-color clutter on the parents' screens).
keyCharacteristics: A calm, cool board. The only strong color belongs to people, plus a few status colors.
Rounded everything: pill buttons and tabs, 18 to 32px cards, circular faces.
Fredoka for anything you'd read from across the room; Figtree for everything you read up close.
Emoji as the picture layer, beside text and never instead of it for adults.
Shadows that are soft and low, used to lift panels off the board rather than to stack layers.
Motion that rewards: stamps, pops and confetti on completion, with all of it off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The People Own the Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated hues on screen belong to a person or a status. Never add a brand accent, decorative gradient or category color to the app shell. Categories show as emoji, not color.

rules.name: The Mixed, Not Painted Rule
rules.body: Person colors reach surfaces only through `color-mix` with the surface (7 to 22%). Full-strength person color is kept for rings, dots, borders and the "done" star.

rules.name: The Solo Tint Rule
rules.body: An event row takes its person's tint (11 to 12%; 20% in dark mode, so it separates from the panel) only when exactly one person goes. A shared event stays neutral Cloud and its faces say who. Who and kind are never shown with a colored side stripe. This holds for the Today timeline, the Month agenda and the Tomorrow board.

rules.name: The Bedside Rule
rules.body: After night mode starts, nothing on the hub glows: amber on black, no person colors, no solid fills and no shadows. Actions (the active tab, the + button, "Got it") become amber outlines (`inset 0 0 0 1.5px`, amber at 60%) instead of solid pills.

rules.name: The Across-the-Room Rule
rules.body: Anything meant to be glanced at (times, names, titles, counts, the clock, kid-mode words) is set in Fredoka. Anything meant to be read up close (notes, form labels, settings copy) is Figtree.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Clocks and counts use tabular numbers so they don't jitter as they tick.

rules.name: The Six Sizes Rule
rules.body: Text takes one of six role sizes (label, small, body, small title, title, large title) through the `--fs-*` variables; a new screen picks a role, never a new number. Body and form fields never go below 16px, so phones don't zoom into a field when it's tapped.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Content sits one level above the board, never more. Stacked cards-in-cards with their own shadows are not allowed; nested surfaces change tone instead.

dos: Do give every person-related element the person's color through `--pc` (set with `pc()`), mixed 7 to 22% into the surface for fills.
Do pair every item with an emoji, and mark decorative emoji `aria-hidden` when text sits beside it.
Do use Fredoka for anything glanceable and Figtree for anything read up close.
Do keep one Ink Navy primary action per sheet or panel, as a full pill.
Do show "now" and conflicts with a 2px inset ring, not by changing size or layout.
Do celebrate completion (stamp, pop, confetti) and turn all motion off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep touch targets big: 64px number keys, 104px or larger tiles, 64px + button.
Do tint an event row with its person's color only when one person goes; leave shared events neutral and let the faces say who.
Do switch anything left on at night to Bedside Amber on black, with amber outlines for actions.
donts: Don't drift toward a corporate calendar: no thin-ruled dense grids, no grey boxed cells packed with small text, no square corners.
Don't go babyish on the parents' screens: no rainbow fills, extra colors, bouncing or confetti in Settings, forms, the week grid or the nudge feed. Keep the play for kid mode, tiles and completion.
Don't introduce a brand color, gradient or category color into the shell. Saturated color is for people and status only.
Don't stack shadowed cards inside shadowed panels. Nest with tone (Cloud on Paper White) instead.
Don't rely on text alone on kid-facing screens. A picture, a face or a color has to carry the meaning too.
Don't use full-strength person color as small text. Mix it with Tint Ink first so it stays readable.
Don't mark who or what kind with a colored side stripe on cards or rows. Use a tint, faces or an icon tile.
Don't let person colors, solid fills or shadows glow on the hub at night.
